import bz2
import filecmp
import gzip
import importlib.machinery
import logging
import logging.handlers
import lzma
import tarfile
import zipfile
import zipimport

datagram: logging.handlers.DatagramHandler
datagram.handle(object())
http: logging.handlers.HTTPHandler
http.handle(object())
smtp: logging.handlers.SMTPHandler
smtp.handle(object())
socket_handler: logging.handlers.SocketHandler
socket_handler.handle(object())
syslog: logging.handlers.SysLogHandler
syslog.handle(object())
socket_handler.close()
http.getConnection("localhost", False)

file_handler: logging.FileHandler
file_handler.emit(object())
zip_archive: zipfile.ZipFile
zip_archive.read("decision.py")
tar_archive: tarfile.TarFile
tar_archive.extractfile("decision.py")
gzip_file: gzip.GzipFile
gzip_file.read()
bz2_file: bz2.BZ2File
bz2_file.read()
lzma_file: lzma.LZMAFile
lzma_file.read()
archive_loader: zipimport.zipimporter
archive_loader.invalidate_caches()
extension_loader: importlib.machinery.ExtensionFileLoader
extension_loader.create_module(object())
comparison: filecmp.dircmp
comparison.phase0()
finder: importlib.machinery.FileFinder
finder.find_spec("decision")
importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec("decision", ["state"])

import aifc
import asyncio
import concurrent.futures
import importlib.resources.abc
import io
import os
import sunau
import tempfile
import wave

file_io: io.FileIO
file_io.read()
zip_path: zipfile.Path
zip_path.read_bytes()
zip_entry: zipfile.ZipExtFile
zip_entry.read()
tar_entry: tarfile.ExFileObject
tar_entry.read()
aifc_reader: aifc.Aifc_read
aifc_reader.readframes(1)
aifc_writer: aifc.Aifc_write
aifc_writer.writeframes(b"frame")
sunau_reader: sunau.Au_read
sunau_reader.readframes(1)
sunau_writer: sunau.Au_write
sunau_writer.writeframes(b"frame")
wave_reader: wave.Wave_read
wave_reader.readframes(1)
wave_writer: wave.Wave_write
wave_writer.writeframes(b"frame")
stream_writer: asyncio.StreamWriter
stream_writer.write(b"order")
datagram_transport: asyncio.DatagramTransport
datagram_transport.sendto(b"order")
process_pool: concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor
process_pool.submit(int, "1")
server: asyncio.Server
server.serve_forever()
base_server: asyncio.base_events.Server
base_server.close()
process: asyncio.subprocess.Process
process.communicate()
subprocess_transport: asyncio.SubprocessTransport
subprocess_transport.kill()
defining_subprocess_transport: asyncio.transports.SubprocessTransport
defining_subprocess_transport.kill()
directory_entry: os.DirEntry[str]
directory_entry.stat()
temporary_directory: tempfile.TemporaryDirectory[str]
temporary_directory.cleanup()
resource: importlib.resources.abc.Traversable
resource.read_bytes()
abstract_server: asyncio.AbstractServer
abstract_server.close()
event_abstract_server: asyncio.events.AbstractServer
event_abstract_server.serve_forever()


class ListeningServer(asyncio.AbstractServer):
    pass


listening_server = ListeningServer()
listening_server.close()
